finite_buffer_capacity.admission_rule: Count ceiling AND actual footprint/orientation/payload compatibility of the assigned finite staging area; count alone never guarantees fit.
finite_buffer_capacity.blocking_rule: Reserve an admissible staging position before intake. When none is available, hold upstream; no cargo waits in the keep-clear approach or teleports to storage.

service_time_rule.resource_motion: Actual actor/vehicle travel and exclusive reservations must appear separately in the source-labelled timeline.
service_time_rule.scope: Synthetic intake/unload/check/release to reserved staging; excludes resource travel, queueing, putaway and other operational legs.

gate_constraints.gate_motion_rule: Straight aligned crossing only. Enter fully before turning inbound; finish internal turn before aligned outbound crossing. No turn inside the wall aperture.

loaded_profile.support_assumption_scope: Synthetic design target; actual mesh/contacts/retention/transfer need bound M/P evidence.

rating_requirements.frozen_selection: Replaces v0.1 600kgm before stock/optimization: extended654kg IBC at1.0m needs explicit larger declared design. Same rating in both A/B cases; not a measured improvement.
rating_requirements.meaning: Declared simulation equipment rating, not calculated structural stability or a real manufacturer's capacity plate.
rating_requirements.reach_rule: Reach shifts load AND fork heel forward. Physical fork load-centre is unchanged, but moment arm about fixed chassis reference increases by .40m; capacity must use that increased arm.
